title: Structural Results for 4 x n Chomp: Unique Extension, Bimodal Asymptotic Structure, and Period-112 Geometry
summary: We present a complete computational tabulation of all 961,619,972 P-positions in 4xn Chomp for n 2/9 is shown to be a mixture artifact. Third, within each family the two larger row-length ratios satisfy an exact quadratic relation at machine precision, and numerical evidence suggests d/a -> 1/4 in the HIGH family, though a power-law convergence fit gives an asymptote of approximately 0.248 with exponent alpha ~ 0.05, leaving the exact limit open.
